facts.fact: The Guardian reports that a Cairo court convicted Mada Masr editor Lina Attalah of managing an unlicensed website, she was held until a EGP 3 million fine was paid, and the court ordered the Mada Masr site shut; the outlet says it had applied for a licence three years earlier without reply.

EGY.note: The Matsadaash arrests are described here as charges of belonging to the Muslim Brotherhood, not speech.
